meta.name: Bodkin
meta.description:
A ragtag crew of podcasters sets out to investigate mysterious disappearances from decades earlier in a charming Irish town with dark, dreadful secrets.

Complete series. On your server: S1 7/7

videos.title: One True Mystery
videos.overview: A hard-nosed journalist grudgingly works with a true-crime podcaster on a strange case in a small Irish town where the locals want to bury the past.

videos.title: Who We Are
videos.overview: Dove and Gilbert clash over their differing interview approaches — but as they inch closer to answers, their personal struggles add to their problems.

videos.title: Perfectly Innocent Life
videos.overview: The group digs for more clues after a beloved local's death. New details about the Samhain disappearances force Dove to wade through murky territory.

videos.title: Poison or Something
videos.overview: The crew's investigation takes a bizarre turn, jeopardizing their podcast. Gilbert attempts to settle a debt, while Dove gives Emmy harsh advice.

videos.title: Peace in Our Time
videos.overview: Gilbert learns about Bodkin's shady dealings. Dove stirs up trouble at the pub. With new evidence, the crew pieces together a shocking narrative.

videos.title: Ends Justify Means
videos.overview: Back at Inish Mac Tire, Dove and Emmy seek answers but get sidetracked by troubling visions — and revelations. Gilbert deals with a daunting dilemma.

videos.title: Empty Your Pockets
videos.overview: The Samhain festival opens old wounds amid hidden threats. As their pursuit of the truth comes to an end, Dove, Gilbert and Emmy embrace new beginnings.

meta.slogan: The real story is just beneath the surface.
